claims.text: The report states that each banknote on the numismatic uncut sheets carries the special serial number KT 04.07.15 to commemorate the Coronation of King Tupou VI on 4 July 2015. The same page records that King Tupou VI launched the new coronation currency series on 29 June 2015.

claims.uncertainty: Evidence tier: a non-ceremonial Tongan public body plus foreign corroboration (to_crown_tupou_vi_coronation_iha_20150704). A statutory central-bank report written after the event, not a palace, PMO or Gazette ceremony record. The coronation is not the start of the reign.
